preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Make release convergence closure-ready by restoring audible one-shot victory output, optimizing and qualifying the intact dense final-wave workload, and delivering a diagnostic-free seven-to-ten-minute five-wave victory and replay path with truthful builds and results.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by one localized product defect and two incomplete qualification surfaces. The dedicated victory player reports a complete source lifecycle while its Effects output is silent, even though an ordinary same-bus cue records correctly; after two treatments, the next repair must isolate the scene/import playback path and restore mixer-visible output without replacing the preserved source recording. The representative 32-enemy workload exists, but llvmpipe evidence cannot establish the 1920x1080 target or retry stability. The authored nine-minute sequence and ordinary-route receipts also exist, but a diagnostic-free five-wave victory with natural upgrades, exactly-once result commit, and clean replay has not been demonstrated.

stop_conditions: Stop audio edits if the ordinary same-bus positive control also becomes silent; that indicates a bus, collector, driver, or persisted-settings fault requiring host diagnosis.
Do not replace or modify the preserved victory source recording, its receipt, the authored Warden package, or the explicit victory-to-Cheer mapping.
Do not lower the 32-live final-wave profile, remove an enemy role or weapon family, or degrade accepted cemetery, lighting, VFX, HUD, or silhouette presentation to obtain a performance pass.
Stop speculative optimization when no candidate-owned hotspot is demonstrated on a representative native renderer; retain telemetry and defer formal qualification to Tester.
Do not use editor-only preparation or advancement actions as evidence for ordinary run completion, build history, victory timing, result commit, or replay.
Stop and repair before handoff if boot, parsing, ordinary combat causality, pause, failure, title navigation, or retry regresses.

strategy.rationale: Change strategy after three no-progress rounds: replace deferred-playback assumptions with a differential mixer-route diagnosis and direct restoration, optimize only measured dense-workload owners while preserving presentation, and make the ordinary five-wave transaction—not fixtures—the release authority.

code: GameLoop Runtime reruns native_godot_project and host_godot_boot and requires clean import, parsing, resource loading, and launch with no fatal Godot or GDScript errors.
Inspect release-export guards so tester preparation, advancement, and profiling actions are unavailable outside editor builds.
Verify semantic audio bindings retain the preserved source and receipt, and static ownership inspection finds no duplicate victory authorization route.
